dismissals: Persistent brand-management actions; Archive is destructive, while rename/duplicate/new would alter workspace state.
Persistent brand overview text field; editing it would alter brand content. Its purpose and placeholder are already recorded.
All menu items mutate selected template state; Delete is destructive.
New Template creates persistent content; name and description textboxes directly modify the selected template. Their functions are already mapped.
Would open a native file picker or attach external content; unsafe and not driveable in this backend.
Publish is an externally visible one-way action; the harness refused opening it, so it was deliberately not operated.
Export was blocked by the safety harness as guarded/destructive; it could not be safely inspected without risking a download or external output.
All Insert menu items create or modify document elements; options were fully recorded and deliberately not activated.

All remaining controls are setting choices/sliders in the already-mapped screen-clip defaults panel; operating them would mutate brand state, and the mirrored document-scoped panel has already been mapped.
Remaining entries are project-mutating performance/canvas/copy or download commands; the menu structure and safe Brand, Version History, and settings routes were already mapped.
Remaining choices change the current template's performance mode, canvas size, or loop state; options are already documented.
Remaining image-generation model/count/default choices would change generation defaults or cost credits if used; the picker is already mapped.
Remaining video-generation model/count/default choices would change generation defaults or cost credits if used; the picker is already mapped.
Remaining track rows would alter the draft's background audio and the upload control may open a native file picker; picker contents are already documented.
These are Agent effort setting choices; selecting one would persistently change the default and the full option list is already mapped.
These are Agent model choices; selecting one would persistently change the default and the full option list is already mapped.
Remaining paint types apply immediately to the project background; Solid and Linear were safely inspected and all type names are documented.
These unnamed controls belong to a specific library draft card (open/menu affordances); representative draft opening and card menu behavior were already mapped.
These unnamed controls belong to a specific library draft card; representative card and card-menu interactions were already mapped.
Specific library card open/menu affordances; representative card behavior is already mapped, so this duplicate content row need not be operated.
Specific library card open/menu affordances; representative card behavior is already mapped.
Specific library content card open/menu affordances with an uninformative title; representative card behavior is already mapped.
Specific library draft card; opening/menu interactions duplicate the representative draft already mapped.
Specific library draft card with unread-comment metadata; card open/menu behavior is already mapped, and interacting could alter read state.
Specific library draft card; representative open and ellipsis interactions are already mapped.
Specific repetitive library draft card; representative behavior is already mapped.

These residual top-level items are already-mapped visibility/value choices, clip duration labels, palette/size values, sort/duration options, and font choices. Operating them would mutate content/settings or duplicate picker inspection.
Specific repetitive library draft card; representative open/menu behavior is already mapped.
Specific library content card; representative draft/card menu behavior is already mapped.
Specific library content card; representative draft/card behavior is already mapped.
This is the current-brand choice inside the already-mapped Project actions → Brand submenu; reselecting it is redundant and selecting a brand can alter the document.

These are font-list rows, informational text-style/font-usage affordances, and already-mapped editor insertion/gradient controls. Font selection and adding content/stops would persistently mutate brand or document state.
Add Size would persist a workspace recording-size row; all other entries are font-picker choices whose selection would change the brand font. Both surfaces are already mapped.
These are entries in the already-mapped brand font picker; selecting any would persistently change the brand font.
These are font-family choices in the Brand Kit Type font picker; selecting one would persistently change the brand font, and the picker interaction is already mapped.
Repetitive Primary Font picker choices; selecting any would persistently change the brand font.
Repetitive font choices; selecting changes the brand.
Repetitive Primary Font picker options; selecting any would persistently change the brand font.
Repetitive Primary Font choices; selecting changes the brand font.
Font picker choices; selecting changes brand font.
Font picker choices; selecting changes brand font (including current Inter, which need not be reselected).

Previously inspected controls from settings, brand, editor, and context menus; these are content fields, state-changing choices, clipboard actions, or destructive actions that were deliberately not operated for safety.

Previously seen controls: external/native-file/account actions, persistent editor/brand settings, content notes, or insert actions; all were deliberately left unchanged after their containing surfaces were mapped.
Persistent creation/settings/content controls from already mapped surfaces; operating them would create data or change brand/document/app state. Help/info controls did not reveal additional surfaces.

Previously inspected choices/actions: persistent media/paint/template/settings changes, recording or externally visible sign-in/comment actions, and destructive size removal. They were intentionally not operated.
Previously mapped content/state controls or native-file actions; audio preview is transient, and Your Library is a non-action heading/content element. No further operation is needed.

The two unnamed controls are the draft card body and card overflow affordance for a repetitive library item; representative draft opening and card-menu behavior were already mapped, and further use would duplicate coverage or mutate the item.

Already mapped controls or state-changing/external actions: creation, sorting choices, toggles, brand navigation, publishing, recording, destructive removal, and search fields. Their locations and behavior are documented.
Previously inspected insert/visibility/sort/editor controls or external, account-affecting, destructive, plan, and persistent template actions. They were intentionally not operated for safety.

The six remaining unnamed controls are unlabeled icon affordances already mapped through their surrounding surfaces (sort/menu/upload/editor toolbar variants); invoking them risks duplicate state changes or native/external actions and adds no navigational coverage.
